# Cleaning Agency Playbook — llms.txt
# https://cleaningagencyplaybook.com

## What this site is

Cleaning Agency Playbook is a digital product site selling "The Cleaning Agency Operating System" — a $97 downloadable course that teaches people how to start, run, and scale a residential cleaning agency from zero to $10,000/month in revenue.

## The product

- Name: The Cleaning Agency Operating System
- Price: $97 (one-time)
- Format: 28-slide PDF + editable .pptx
- Delivered via: Gumroad (instant download)
- Guarantee: 30-day money-back

## What the product includes

- Module 1 — Business Foundations: LLC setup, insurance, EIN, tech stack, 12-step launch checklist
- Module 2 — Hiring Great Cleaners: Word-for-word job ad, phone screening script, red flag checklist
- Module 3 — Booking Customers: Full incoming call script, follow-up email template, pricing strategy table
- Module 4 — Daily Operations: Morning/midday/end-of-day checklists, payment flow, legal money rules
- Module 5 — Marketing and Growth: 6 lead channels ranked by ROI, review system, referral strategy
- Module 6 — Scaling to $10K+/Month: Phase-by-phase roadmap, VA hiring system, second service area guide
- Bonus: Cleaning products guide
- Bonus: 10 costly mistakes to avoid

## Who this is for

People starting a residential cleaning agency from zero — no industry experience required. The model is management-based: the owner hires self-employed cleaners, books clients, and manages operations without doing any cleaning themselves.

## Key topics covered on this site

- How to start a cleaning business with no experience
- How to hire reliable cleaners
- How to price cleaning services
- How to get clients for a cleaning business
- Cleaning business phone scripts
- How to scale a cleaning business to $10K/month
- Cleaning agency operations and daily systems

## About

This product is built by an active cleaning agency owner — not a researcher or content creator. The scripts, templates, and pricing tables are pulled from a real agency currently in operation.
